steps.title: Prepare Genomic Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of β-mercaptoethanol to 100 mL of Genomic Lysis Buffer and cap the bottle tightly after each use.

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Lysis
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for nucleic acid extraction in a sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of sample to a pre-labeled sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 5 µL of Internal Control (provided with the amplification kit) and vortex for 30 seconds.
Add 400 µL of Genomic Lysis Buffer and 10 µL of Proteinase K to the sample.
Vortex and incubate the sample at 56 °C for 3 - 5 hours or overnight.
Vortex the sample at 3000 rpm for 30 seconds.

steps.title: DNA Extraction and Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the DNA using a Zymo-Spin IIC Column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the entire content of the 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube into a Zymo-Spin IIC Column in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 10000 rpm for 1 minute and discard the flow-through liquid.
Transfer the Zymo-Spin IIC column into a new collection tube.
Add 200 µL of DNA Pre-Wash Buffer to the spin column, centrifuge at 10000 rpm for 1 minute, and discard the flow-through liquid.
Add 500 µL of gDNA Wash Buffer to the spin column, centrifuge at 10000 rpm for 1 minute, and discard the flow-through liquid.
Transfer the Zymo-Spin IIC Column into a sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: DNA Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA and store it for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL (range 70 - 100 µL) of DNA Elution Buffer to the spin column and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at 13000 rpm for 30 seconds to elute the DNA.
Store the viral nucleic acid at -20 °C pending further analysis.

steps.title: PCR Reaction Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR reaction using the Bosphore HBV Quantification kit.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the PCR Master Mix and other kit components completely at 4 °C before use; do not centrifuge to thaw.
Prepare a 25 µL reaction consisting of 15 µL PCR Master mix and 10 µL of Test Nucleic acid/Standards/Negative Control/Positive Control.
Identify and arrange unknown samples, standards (1-4), positive control, and negative control on the plate.

steps.title: PCR Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Run the PCR under the following cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: Initial Denaturation: 95 °C for 14:30 minutes.
Denaturation: 97 °C for 00:30 minutes (50 cycles).
Annealing and Synthesis (Data Collection): 54 °C for 01:30 minutes (50 cycles).
Hold: 32 °C for 01:00 minute.

steps.title: Data Analysis and Interpretation
steps.instruction: Analyze the FAM channel for threshold crossing and interpret results based on HBV and Internal Control amplification.

substeps.instruction: Identify samples crossing the threshold in the FAM channel to determine starting quantities and Ct-values; others are marked 'No Ct' or '–'.
Interpret results: HBV(+) / IC(+) = HBV Positive; HBV(+) / IC(-) = HBV Positive (high viral load may suppress IC); HBV(-) / IC(+) = HBV Negative; HBV(-) / IC(-) = Invalid.

steps.title: Troubleshooting and Repeat Assay
steps.instruction: Perform corrective actions for invalid or ambiguous results.

substeps.instruction: For HBV(+) / IC(-) results: Freeze the nucleic acid sample (≤ -10 °C) for 20 minutes, defrost at room temperature for 10 minutes, and dilute with nuclease-free water in a 1:2 ratio before repeating the assay.
For Invalid results: Repeat the assay once to account for pipetting errors. If failure persists, collect a new specimen and repeat the entire process from isolation to amplification.
